name: CoP - Provider B Approved Then No-op PUT
description: Provider A submits a learner (unapproved). Provider B submits the same learner on the same course (unapproved). Employer approves Provider B's record. Provider B then sends a PUT with no changes from their original POST.

steps.name: SLD (Provider A) Creates a Short Course
SLD (Provider B) Creates a Short Course
Employer Approves Provider B Short Course
SLD (Provider B) Sends No-op PUT (no changes from POST)
